newsitem.title: USA: US T-bond drops over point on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: US T-bond drops over point on technical selling.

text.p: The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond fell more than a full point on Thursday on technically motivated selling, analysts said.

"The talk was that the market would test 114-30 on the March T-bond contract and that if that didn't hold, the next support was 114-12," said Anthony Karydakis, senior financial economist at First National Bank of Chicago.

"Ahead of (Friday's November) employment report, technicals are clearly driving the market," said Karydakis. "People are looking around to see where they stand and they wanted to play by the rules of the charts and the charts turned bearish because the 114-30 support didn't hold. We went through that rather easily and beyond that, there was a big gap and now we're testing the next support area."

Karydakis said there was an overall feeling in the market that portfolios are where they want to be and that there would not be much to feed the market until the employment data on friday and next week's economic data.
"In the absence of anything else, technicals dominate trading and technicals starting looking bad today," he said.
